subject: Prompt Workbench — aligning calendar windows + load test plan

Subject: Re: Intro + prompt review session availability

Connor — thanks for the quick demo yesterday. We want to move to a hands-on session where our ML infra and product teams walk through our prompt inventory, routing requirements, and run a modest load test to validate latency at P95.

High-level asks from our side: 
- 90-minute workshop with a 45-minute hands-on prompt review and 30-minute routing/load test window (plus 15 min buffer).
- Keep the session in PST if possible (most of our team is based in the Bay Area).
- We'll bring a ~60-row prompt inventory export (CSV). Can you confirm data sanitization best practices?

Attaching the inventory export now. Let us know 2-3 slot options this week.

Thanks,
Lena
Product Ops | Novacare Health
attachment: novacare_prompt_inventory.xlsx

Hi Lena — great to hear you want to jump into a hands-on run. Proposed plan below and a few clarifying Qs.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu 2026-09-16, 10:30–12:00 (preferred)
- Fri 2026-09-17, 13:00–14:30
- Mon 2026-09-20, 09:00–10:30

Proposed agenda (90m):
1) 10m — quick context + objectives
2) 45m — prompt inventory walkthrough & guardrail discussion (structured output templates, failure modes)
3) 25m — routing topology and model variant mapping (latency vs cost trade-offs)
4) 10m — light load test and immediate observations

Clarifying Qs: 
- Do you want Redwood to run load from our hosted region (us-west-2) or from a dedicated bucket inside your VPC?
- Any max token/window constraints for the prompts we should respect during the load run?

Ben, Marissa — can you join the session for the load-test orchestration and structured output template review? I’ll share a short runbook and a load-test plan (pdf) before the call.

Connor Obrien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0139

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + prompt review session availability

Connor — noted. I can run the load orchestration if we do it from Redwood-hosted infra (quicker to spin up). If they need VPC-based tests we’ll need their network egress window and a short IAM/KMS key exchange.

Initial test plan (summary):
- Target traffic: 50 concurrent prompt requests (mixed lengths) for 10 min to capture warm cache characteristics.
- Metrics to capture: P50/P95 latency, NVLink utilization, token throughput, and error rates.
- Fallback: auto-switch to a cheaper variant if latency breaches 1.5x SLA.

I’ll draft the pdf and attach to Connor’s calendar invite.

—Ben
